extraction.name: SciQ
extraction.description: A dataset of 13.7K multiple choice science exam questions
extraction.creator: Johannes Welbl, Nelson F. Liu, Matt Gardner
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was collected using a two-step process: first, crowd workers were presented with a set of candidate passages and asked to generate a question about one of them. Second, another worker took the question and answer generated in the first step and produced three distractors, aided by a model trained to predict good answer distractors.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection consists of science study textbooks and articles from Simple Wikipedia
extraction.rai:dataCollectionTimeframe: The data collection process took place over a period of time, with a total budget of $10,415, and resulted in 13,679 multiple choice science questions
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The data manipulation process involved filtering out irrelevant documents and generating plausible answer distractors using a model
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The data preprocessing protocol involved filtering out paragraphs that were not suitable for generating questions, and then presenting the filtered text to crowd workers
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The data annotation protocol involved crowd workers generating questions about a passage and then selecting or generating distractors
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: The annotations were analyzed to ensure that the questions and distractors were of high quality
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: The crowd workers were Master's status holders on Amazon Mechanical Turk
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: A model trained to predict good answer distractors was used to aid the crowd workers
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The dataset is available for research purposes, and the maintainers plan to update it periodically
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset has the potential to improve the performance of models on science exam questions, which could have a positive social impact on education
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may contain biases towards certain topics or types of questions
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The dataset has limitations in terms of its size and scope, and may not be representative of all science exam questions
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset can be used for training models to answer science exam questions, and for evaluating the performance of such models
